mapper.insert: INSERT INTO dividend_income_record (user_id, account_id, symbol, symbol_name, market, ex_dividend_date, quantity, dividend_per_share, dividend_amount, currency, cny_rate, dividend_amount_cny) VALUES (#{userId}, #{accountId}, #{symbol}, #{symbolName}, #{market}, #{exDividendDate}, #{quantity}, #{dividendPerShare}, #{dividendAmount}, #{currency}, #{cnyRate}, #{dividendAmountCny}) ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE symbol_name = VALUES(symbol_name), quantity = VALUES(quantity), dividend_per_share = VALUES(dividend_per_share), dividend_amount = VALUES(dividend_amount), currency = VALUES(currency), cny_rate = VALUES(cny_rate), dividend_amount_cny = VALUES(dividend_amount_cny)

INSERT INTO dividend_income_record (user_id, account_id, symbol, symbol_name, market, ex_dividend_date, quantity, dividend_per_share, dividend_amount, currency, cny_rate, dividend_amount_cny) VALUES
(#{r.userId}, #{r.accountId}, #{r.symbol}, #{r.symbolName}, #{r.market}, #{r.exDividendDate}, #{r.quantity}, #{r.dividendPerShare}, #{r.dividendAmount}, #{r.currency}, #{r.cnyRate}, #{r.dividendAmountCny})
ON DUPLICATE KEY UPDATE symbol_name = VALUES(symbol_name), quantity = VALUES(quantity), dividend_per_share = VALUES(dividend_per_share), dividend_amount = VALUES(dividend_amount), currency = VALUES(currency), cny_rate = VALUES(cny_rate), dividend_amount_cny = VALUES(dividend_amount_cny)
mapper.select: SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ex_dividend_date, '%Y-%m') AS month, SUM(dividend_amount_cny) AS total FROM dividend_income_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND ex_dividend_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(ex_dividend_date, '%Y-%m') ORDER BY month ASC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(ex_dividend_date, '%Y') AS year, SUM(dividend_amount_cny) AS total FROM dividend_income_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND ex_dividend_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(ex_dividend_date, '%Y') ORDER BY year ASC

SELECT symbol, MAX(symbol_name) AS symbolName, MAX(market) AS market, SUM(dividend_amount_cny) AS totalDividendCny, SUM(dividend_amount) AS totalDividendOriginal, MAX(currency) AS currency, COUNT(*) AS eventCount FROM dividend_income_record WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND ex_dividend_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} GROUP BY symbol ORDER BY totalDividendCny DESC
